'''''Lavandula canariensis''''' (common name, '''Canary Island lavender''') is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Lamiaceae]], native to the [[Canary Islands]].<ref name=WCSP_108993/> It was first described by [[Philip Miller]] in 1768.<ref name=IPNI_449023-1/><ref name=Tropicos_100213493/>

== Description ==
''Lavandula canariensis'' is a half-hardy, woody, evergreen shrub. The leaves are [[bipinnate]], rich green,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Lavandula canariensis {{!}} Canary Island Lavender {{!}} Lavender {{!}} plant lust |url=https://plantlust.com/plants/4990/lavandula-canariensis/ |access-date=2024-06-21 |website=plantlust.com |language=en}}</ref> and covered in fine, downy hairs. Flowers appear in spikes of small, fragrant blue, opening from dark purple buds, and are borne on branching stems in summer.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Lavandula canariensis {{!}} Shrubs/RHS Gardening |url=http://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/9880/lavandula-canariensis/details |access-date=2024-06-21 |website=www.rhs.org.uk |language=en-gb}}</ref><gallery mode=packed heights=180>
